verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents Payment Links as 'the easiest way to accept payments online without a digital storefront' and Invoicing generates 'digital payment links' with 160+ local payment methods, directly matching the no-code shareable-link story. However, all evidence is developer-docs oriented (API/CLI-centric framing) with no dashboard UI walkthrough, no screenshots, and no independent/community confirmation of the actual no-code dashboard flow or time-to-first-sale experience. Missing for 10: dashboard UI evidence/screenshots showing the no-code link creation flow, independent user reports confirming ease of setup, and any onboarding/KYC friction details before a founder can actually start selling.
